Introduction

PIXY was a five-member girl group under ALLART Entertainment and Happy Tribe Entertainment. They released their debut single, "Wings", as a six-members group on February 24, 2021.

The group, originally composed of Ella, Lola, Satbyeol, Dia, Sua, and Dajeong, went throught a lineup change as both Ella and Satbyeol left the group on August 27, 2022, and were replaced by Rinji on September 27, 2022. Her first promotion as part of the group was the start of their 1st European tour "Wanna Be Your Villian" on October 13, 2022.

After that, Dajeong left the group on June 20, 2024, and Lola on September 15, 2024. Rinji was also called a "former member of PIXY" at her graduation from Hanlim Multi-Art School on February 20, 2025. Due to the group's inactivity, the fact that Dia and Sua are the only two members that haven't stated leaving the group, and the company shutting down, it is safe to assume that PIXY quietly disbanded.
